characters.name: The ferry
characters.description: A harbour ferry built as one long covered hall with two identical working ends, gates along both sides and benches across its width.
characters.appearance: A low, even body with the same profile at both ends, one continuous roof, and a long band of sliding gates along each side; a small glazed helm cabin sits on the roof at mid-length, above a crew stair.

characters.name: The design team
characters.description: The studio team that settles how people move on and off the ferry.
characters.personality: Works by laying things out and turning them over, with few words.
characters.appearance: A small group in work clothes gathered round a long table.

characters.name: Operator representatives
characters.description: The people from the operator who will run the ferry and who bring the question of every stop.
characters.personality: Practical, and quick to try things with their own hands.
characters.appearance: Two or three people in the operator's jackets.

characters.name: Yard crews
characters.description: The crews who set out and raise the hull structure in the building hall.
characters.appearance: Crews in overalls and hard hats working along the length of the hull.

characters.name: Site engineers
characters.description: The engineers who hold the drawings against the steel as it goes up.
characters.appearance: A pair of engineers carrying rolled drawings.

characters.name: Fitting-out crews
characters.description: The crews who hang the gates, fix the benches and glaze the helm cabin.
characters.appearance: Crews with tool belts working gate by gate along both sides.

characters.name: The master
characters.description: The ferry's master, who is put in charge of it at completion.
characters.personality: Says little and watches how things move.
characters.appearance: A weathered person in a dark uniform jacket.

characters.name: The crew
characters.description: The deck crew who work the gates at every pier.
characters.appearance: Two deck hands in high-visibility vests.

characters.name: The passengers
characters.description: People crossing the harbour on ordinary errands.
characters.appearance: A mixed crowd with bags, bicycles and coffee cups.
